summary: Stocks closed broadly higher into quarterly options expiration Friday, with the Dow up 0.6% to 51,778.04 as all three major benchmarks finished in the green, though gains stayed concentrated in mega-cap tech. Firm real yields and a resilient dollar kept gold pinned near recent lows, while calm volatility left broader sentiment little changed into the weekend.
tweet: Dow closed up 0.6% to 51,778 on quad-witching Friday as tech led narrow gains, while firm real yields and a strong dollar kept gold under pressure.
